summary: Frontend-only testing of iteration 3 (Practice mode + Export/Import + lesson/exam gating). All 11 requested flows pass end-to-end. Found and fixed one critical undefined-variable bug in Curriculum.jsx that would have crashed the Curriculum page.

ui_bugs.issue: `practiceDone` was referenced (lines 111 & 116) but never declared in the topic .map() callback — would throw ReferenceError and blank the Curriculum page whenever any topic tile renders. FIXED by adding `const practiceDone = !!state.practiceDone?.[topic.id];` inside the map callback.

action_items: Nothing blocking. Code review suggestion: consider deriving `practiceDone` in Curriculum.jsx via a helper (e.g., `isPracticeDone(topicId, state)`) in lib/storage.js so this symmetry with isExamUnlocked stays DRY.

Minor: Exam.jsx line 66 contains a Unicode escape `\u2019` inside a JSX string literal — it renders as the literal text `\u2019` instead of `’` (right single quote). Replace with an actual `’` character for clean UX.
critical_code_review_comments: Curriculum.jsx used undefined `practiceDone` — caught only because tile code paths hit it; must be fixed (done).
Exam.jsx renders `\u2019` as literal text (escape sequences don't expand inside JSX string literals).
storage.js importAllData performs no schema validation of `payload.main`; a malformed file would overwrite good progress. Consider shape-check + a confirmation dialog before overwrite.
Dashboard.jsx exportAllData triggers `a.click()` without appending to document — works in Chromium but not reliable on Firefox; consider `document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();`.

Practice.jsx uses `finished` state seeded from loadState() but the banner's `Save & unlock exam` button is only shown when `!finished` — if the user reloads mid-practice after completing, they can't re-click Save, which is fine, but the `practice-to-exam` still shows. OK.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage key py_academy_v1 with { studentName:'TestUser', ... } to skip landing and exercise dashboard/curriculum/lesson/practice/exam flows. Cleared between phases for regression checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 complete. Verified full happy path /learn/intro → /practice/intro (wrong-then-retry, then 100%) → /exam/intro (100%) → /learn/variables unlocked. Verified exam-locked-screen + goto-practice-link before practice; exam-locked-note replacing take-exam-btn on lesson until practice done. Export/Import round-trip verified: downloaded JSON had version=1 and main.studentName=TestUser; re-imported into empty localStorage restored practiceDone.intro and completed.intro. Curriculum tile shows PRACTICE DONE · EXAM READY badge correctly after fix. Hero stats 27/135+/13 present on landing.
rca_of_fix: Curriculum.jsx referenced `practiceDone` in two JSX conditionals without declaring it. Fix: added `const practiceDone = !!state.practiceDone?.[topic.id];` alongside the existing `unlocked`/`done`/`score` locals inside the per-topic .map() callback. Reproduction before fix: navigate to /curriculum — React throws ReferenceError and Curriculum section renders blank/error.
